omission_or_limit: A direct hit on the seed gene itself (diagnostic arm) is executed and signed but never shown beside the hand-over rows of the same question and arm
first_case_and_reasons: omaveloxolone, reason O3/T8: Q8 direct_search rank 1-2 signed +1 (opposes); absent from the Q8 hand-over (tapinarof 1008, GSK2816126 0993)
proposed_small_general_fix: In the hand-over row, add one field: signed direct hits on the question seed genes (small molecule, approved or with an earlier decision), with their earlier-decision state. A read-only join of two existing tables; no ranking change
second_case_read: Q2 (pracinostat/vorinostat rows): eng_merged/candidates_Q2.tsv holds 5 signed direct-search rows (PKM2 activators, one anonymous compound); Q5: 12+ signed rows, all biologics (etanercept, adalimumab ...)
test_evidence_and_caveats: Mechanically applies to Q2 and Q5 rows too. Without the filter (small molecule, approved or decided) Q5 would print only antibodies and Q2 an anonymous compound, so the value is high for Q8 and low elsewhere. Does not touch scoring.

omission_or_limit: A class-level limit has no scope in the decision table (scopes are molecule, premise_refuted, premise_unresolved, work_done), so class limits live in free text of one member and reach no sibling
first_case_and_reasons: EZH2 (reasons E7 differentiation hazard, E8 P-gp/BCRP efflux, class part of E9): 0198-0200 and 0993-0995 print "dev limits: unspecified" and an empty limit list on Q8 rows
proposed_small_general_fix: Add a fifth scope class_limit with premise_key target:GENE (or target-class) that travels as a carried limit to every member whose main target matches, never as a veto
second_case_read: HDAC5 cluster (pracinostat 0005, CUDC-101, quisinostat): card A01 DR-A01-005/007 records that class I HDAC action did not reproduce the soluble mutant gain and worsened one EEG count; nothing of it is in any limit of the HDAC5 rows
test_evidence_and_caveats: Second case read: pracinostat handoff carried_limits = second-system gate + the nanatinostat edge note only. A01 is a card, so a scope row would cite the card, not a P4a record. Risk: a class_limit must be limit-only; as a veto it would repeat the pre-H8 failure.

omission_or_limit: A seed guard that belongs to a deposit is attached by seed id, so a new seed from the same deposit misses it
first_case_and_reasons: S132 NFE2L2 (T3): second system GSE126075 failed gate 1 in the progenitor arm; S017-S022 carry SECOND_SYSTEM_GATE_FAILED, S132 carries none, so Q8 rows have an empty carried_limits
proposed_small_general_fix: Derive the annotation from the second-system deposit named in the seed row (GSE126075 plus the module RESULTS section), not from a hand list of seed ids
second_case_read: the two Q8 hand-over rows (tapinarof 1008, GSK2816126 0993) both use S132 and are both affected; Q2 rows already carry it by hand
test_evidence_and_caveats: Verified in inputs_it22/seed_annotations.tsv and seeds.tsv. Caveat: the failed gate concerns the progenitor arm only (WWOX lower in neurons, centred log2 about -0.87), so it is a limit, not a veto. Q3 seeds S049-S052 cite GSE126075 as primary system; not tested whether the rule applies to them.

omission_or_limit: The hand-over prints "dev limits: unspecified" for 16 of 16 hand-overs although the catalogue holds ATC, route products and (via the bridge) phase
first_case_and_reasons: tapinarof T5: ATC D05AX07, IT9 F2_topical_only, profile topical True; pracinostat H3: phase blank though ChEMBL says 3.0
proposed_small_general_fix: Read ATC group, route flags and max_phase from the catalogue record of the (bridged) ChEMBL id into the dev-limits sentence; keep "unspecified" only when the record is empty. Also state the IT9/IT10 earlier-exclusion class (F2, F5, E6) as a limit, not only as earlier_thread
second_case_read: pracinostat/quisinostat/vorinostat (bridged DGIdb twins): all 112 bridged rows have blank max_phase (counted); vorinostat is approved only via status_class
test_evidence_and_caveats: Tapinarof gains a route limit; the three HDAC twins gain a phase. dev_constraints.tsv holds only 5 hand-curated rows, none for omaveloxolone, so a catalogue read is the only automatic source. Not verified: which catalogue field carries route (ATC and openFDA products are present; the profile topical flag is IT9-only).

omission_or_limit: Attribution compares the main target with the single best target only; a pan-target compound reads as "ATTRIBUTABLE"
first_case_and_reasons: pracinostat H4 (HDAC1 49, HDAC3 43, HDAC10 40, HDAC5 47 nM) and CUDC-101 H6 (EGFR 2.4, ERBB2 15.7, 8 targets within 10x of best)
proposed_small_general_fix: Add to attribution_note the count and names of other measured targets within the same fold of the main target (values_kept already holds them)
second_case_read: ibrutinib (BTK 1 nM; BLK 0.3, BMX 0.8, TXK 2: 11 targets within 10x of main) and valemetostat/tulmimetostat (EZH1 3.1x and 3.0x) once joined
test_evidence_and_caveats: Counted over the 106 assessed rows that are ATTRIBUTABLE, BORDERLINE or SECONDARY: 55 have two or more other targets within 10x of the main target. It does not change any state, only the sentence.

omission_or_limit: A GtoPdb ligand with no ChEMBL id cannot be joined, so its typed values are lost to the screen
first_case_and_reasons: tazemetostat (E4): GtoPdb ligand 7011 has no ChEMBL id; its full InChIKey NSQSAUGJQHDYNO-UHFFFAOYSA-N equals catalogue CAT:CHEMBL3414621; the proposal is NOT_ASSESSABLE
proposed_small_general_fix: Allow a join on equal full InChIKey when the ligand record has no ChEMBL id (same rule as the V1 bridge, structure equal plus name check)
second_case_read: valemetostat and tulmimetostat: GtoPdb ligands carry ChEMBL ids but the catalogue has no family for them (no InChIKey match), so the fix does NOT help; pracinostat and quisinostat are already bridged by claim name
test_evidence_and_caveats: Helps tazemetostat only among the six; catalogue-wide up to 758 catalogue ChEMBL records match a GtoPdb ligand lacking a ChEMBL id by full InChIKey (upper bound; overlap with the existing reconciliation not checked). Dual EZH1/2 compounds need a catalogue change, a different fix.

omission_or_limit: The premise key target:BTK@Q4 is keyed on main target and question, not on the seed; a future BTK row through another Q4 seed would be blocked by a refutation about NPY
second_case_read: no second case: target: keys occur once in decision_scope_it22.tsv (the other keys are edge:)
test_evidence_and_caveats: No leak today: all 57 BTK rows are NPY-first and all 24 blocked rows have the NPY chain. Specific to one row; not general.

omission_or_limit: A carried limit keeps the wording of the record that created it after a later dossier corrects it
first_case_and_reasons: EZH2 Q5 siblings (E6): IT21 wording vs IT22 P6 correction (DZNep/siEZH2, microglial IL1B/IL6 unchanged)
proposed_small_general_fix: Process rule: when a dossier corrects a decision source, add a corrections row to the scope table
second_case_read: no second case among the six: no other limit text was corrected in IT22
test_evidence_and_caveats: A data edit, not a code rule; mentioned so it is not mistaken for a general fix.
